title: Crispy Gallega Fried Cauliflower
description: A vegetarian twist on traditional Spanish cuisine, this crispy fried cauliflower dish is a delicious and satisfying meal. The combination of crispy exterior and tender interior will leave you wanting more.
instructions: 2. Rinse the cauliflower and break it into florets.
3. In a shallow dish, mix together the a la gallega and olive oil.
4. Dip each cauliflower floret into the a la gallega mixture, coating completely.
5. Roll the coated cauliflower in the crispy breadcrumbs to coat.
6. Place the coated cauliflower on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
7. Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until crispy and golden brown.
